feeds.title: Clinic Psychology Blog
feeds.description: We, at Clinic Psychology Manitoba, are a group of psychologists in Winnipeg, dedicated to working with clients in improving their mental health. We specialize in evidence-based treatment strategies that primarily include cognitive behaviour therapy (CBT), and mindfulness based approaches.

feeds.title: Veronica Walsh's CBT Blog
feeds.description: I (Veronica Walsh of CBT and Feeling Good) am a qualified and experienced trainer, and a qualified Cognitive Behavioural Therapist and I combine the two skillsets to provide low intensity CBT, either through private sessions in Dublin's city centre, or through group workshops.

feeds.title: Inner Acceptance Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Licensed Mental Health Therapists and Counselors provide a safe space to inspire a sense of connection, inner acceptance, and positive change. At Inner Acceptance Therapy our Licensed Mental Health Therapists and Counselors are here to help improve your quality of life and find your true happiness!

feeds.title: CBT Professionals Blog
feeds.description: CBT Professionals are a team of 20 psychologists and 8 administration staff, selected based on a uniting set of values that define us as a truly caring practice. We provide clinical psychology services for Adults, Children, Couples, Families, and third parties, across our two psychology clinics conveniently located in the central and northern Gold Coast regions.

feeds.title: CBT
feeds.description: Notes from the CBT books I study to support my work as a psychotherapist. I have worked for over 7 years as a psychotherapist for adults: with the NHS in 3 trusts, the Rock Clinic, KCA CRI Equinox and privately. Follow this blog for more information on CBT.

feeds.title: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Los Angeles Blog
feeds.description: Want to learn more about Cognitive Behavioral Therapy? Visit here to read our psychology blog highlighting CBT Techniques.

feeds.title: Blogging behavioral
feeds.description: Welcome. I'm Dr. Sandy Andrews, Ph.D., clinical psychologist in Austin, Texas. I specialize in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). My intent here is to share some of what I know about clinical psychology, CBT in particular, and perspectives gained from across the couch

feeds.title: Cleaalber-cbt.com Blog
feeds.description: Clea Alber Cognitive Behavior Therapist Brighton.Clea Alber is a Brighton based Cognitive Behaviour Therapist, accredited by the BABCP (British Association of Behavioural and Cognitive Psychotherapies)

feeds.title: CBT Associates
feeds.description: Here we share our thoughts and new ideas related to Psychological Problems and Cognitive Behavioural Therapy. At CBT Associates we provide psychological assessment and treatment services for children, adolescents and adults.

feeds.title: Collaborative CBT Blog
feeds.description: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy. Think Different, Feel Better. ou deserve a safe space to be heard! — We provide compassionate therapy & counseling for couples, groups, teens, families, and individuals in NYC.

feeds.title: The Harley Psychology Group Blog
feeds.description: The British CBT & Counselling Service are Doctors of Psychology specialising in CBT for adults, families & children. Follow this blog to get a clear understanding of the origins and development of problems and learn comprehensive techniques to eliminate these and prevent their return.

feeds.title: Cognitive Behavior Therapy Center of Southern California Blog
feeds.description: Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (CBT) is a therapeutic approach to treating mood and anxiety related disorders that has been extensively research-validated. In our individual and group treatments, we utilize specialized CBT treatment methods that are tailored for the particular disorder. Follow this blog to help understand and master your problem as quickly as possible.

feeds.title: CBT Westport Blog
feeds.description: A dedicated group of clinical psychologists who specialize in a variety of cognitive and behavior therapies with children, adolescents, and adults
